alerts.title: Main Park Road Closed
alerts.description: 11/1/2026: The Main Park Road is temporarily closed as maintenance staff clear storm debris during an active rain event. Currently, only the Visitor and Research Center near US Highway 160 is accessible. This alert will be removed when the road reopens.

alerts.title: Road Construction
alerts.description: Road work will begin on the first four miles of the Main Park Road during the week of September 20 - 26. Expect delays up to 15 minutes. Far View Sites and Cedar Tree Tower are closed for road improvements.

alerts.title: Limited Drinking Water Filling
alerts.description: Limited drinking water filling is available during the winter season. Bring enough water with you for your visit.
